tasks.label: Build C++
args: $main='${file}'; $dir='${fileDirname}'; $base='${fileBasenameNoExtension}'; $out='${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe'; $sources=@($main); Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Filter ($base + '*.cpp') | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne '${fileBasename}' -and $_.Name -match ('^' + [regex]::Escape($base) + '[a-zA-Z_].*\.cpp$') } | ForEach-Object { $sources += $_.FullName }; & g++ -std=c++17 -g @sources -o $out; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
